### GET `/api/Macro/GetInstalledMacros`

Get a list of all macros and their related applications as installed on the users system Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.Applications.MacroConfigurationNode

### GET `/api/Macro/GetMacroConfigurations`

Get all the macro configurations for the user account Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.Applications.MacroConfigurationNode
